All 608 fixture-required groups map to dedicated canonical fixture source coverage; the additional shell, intake, research, and static-route groups map to bounded source tests. The bounded Research Lab functional slice has a retry-free 182/182 receipt across all 13 configured non-Brain-renderer projects. Current-run whole-manifest assertion receipts, remaining hidden and material state traversal, visual approval, and the complete full-product browser matrix remain release work.
